sentences.text: 2. During the pendency of the petition, the 1st petitioner- husband and the 2nd respondent- wife have settled the dispute amicably and have decided to live together.
A Joint Memo is also filed by them to that effect.

The Joint Memo reads as follows:
"The undersigned counsel for the Petitioners and Respondent No.2 most humbly submits that, at the intervention of elders and well-wishers, the Petitioner No.1 (husband) and Respondent No.2 (wife/Complaint) and other Petitioners being family members have amicably resolved their dispute inter se.
The Petitioner No.1 and Respondent No.2 have reunited by forgetting all the past events and have decided live together to lead life along with their children.

As such,
the Respondent No.2 do not wish to prosecute case against her husband and family members.

Under the aforesaid circumstances, it is prayed that, this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to disposed off the above petition by quashing the FIR in Crime No.302/2022 now as CC No.50350/2023 pending on the file of NC:
2024:KHC:18425 29th Addl Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Bengaluru, in the interest of justice."
The affidavit filed by the 2nd respondent reads as follows:
Page 6 and 7.

"I, Tabassum Fatima W/o Mohammed Muzammil, aged about 26 years, R/at:No.316,
Shree Garnet Park Apartment, Whitefield Main Road, Mahadevapura Post Hoodi,
Bengaluru-560 048 do hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath as under:
1. I state that, I am the Respondent No.2/complainant in the above case, I know the facts of the case.
Hence, am deposing to this affidavit.

2. I state that, at the intervention of elders and well-wishers and considering the welfare of my children, I have decided to withdraw all the pending court cases initiated as against my husband (Respondent No.1) and other family members.
Likewise in Crime No.302/2023 now as CC No.50351/2023 pending on the file of 29th Addl Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Bengaluru.

entities.text: 29th Addl Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. I state that, after realization and understanding the mistakes committed by each other, without any threat or coercion of anyone, I have decided to reunite forgetting all the past events and live life with my husband along with my children together.
As such, I do not wish to prosecute case against my husband and family members.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: WHEREFORE, it is prayed that, this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to accept this affidavit and dispose off the petition as prayed for, in the interest of justice.
I the deponent do hereby verify and state that, what is stated above is true to the best of my knowledge, belief and information.
This is my name and signature."

In the light of the offences being the one punishable under Section 498A of the IPC and also the couple deciding to live together, I deem it appropriate to accept the Joint Memo and close the proceedings against the petitioner.

4. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
ORDER (i) Criminal Petition is disposed.
(ii) Proceedings pending in Crime No.302 of 2022 pending before the 29th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru stands quashed.
Consequently, I.A.No.1 of 2023 also stands disposed.
